items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: He was learning the clarinet about the same time as I was learning the trumpet. I mean the cornet. His name was Elliot Taylor.

ctx.x: No. No. Uh, let me see now. I wanted to ask you about that 1776.

Yeah. They didn't call me 1776. It was the box that I had, the little flip top box for my little cornet. And he's always a fella always wondered whatever happened to him. He was learning the clarinet about the same time as I was learning the trumpet. I mean the cornet. His name was Elliot Taylor. Uh huh. And I think he's the one that gave him that name.
Well he continued on. I know he played the name of him.
